Draft for the iOS and Android apps · Before launch
Tokipin is a journal for iOS and Android. You can use it without an account. The app keeps your notes and drafts in its storage on your device.

Tokipin saves the words, emojis, places and times you enter, along with each note’s date and the order of its items. This lets you keep writing offline, pick up a draft and find or edit a note by date.
Does Tokipin access my location or calendar?
You enter places yourself. Tokipin doesn’t request access to your device’s location or calendar. The app’s calendar shows the notes you’ve made.
How long are notes kept, and how do I delete them?

Find a note in the calendar or through search. You can delete one item or everything you saved for that day. Your notes stay on your device until you delete them or clear the app’s data. Clearing app data removes both notes and drafts from that device.

In Settings, you can export your saved notes as a JSON file. If you delete notes in the app, the exported file stays where you saved it. You can manage it there. Tokipin doesn’t sync notes through an account. Whether a device backup includes or restores your notes depends on your operating system and the app’s backup settings.
These terms apply when you create and browse personal notes in the Tokipin app for iOS and Android.
Without signing up, you can add words, emojis, places and times in any order. Browse by day, month or year, or see just the days with notes. You can also search, edit or delete your notes.
You own the rights to the notes you create. When sharing a note that includes someone else’s writing or personal information outside the app, please respect their rights and privacy.
Changing devices or clearing app data
Tokipin doesn’t sync notes through an account. Before changing devices or clearing the app’s data, export the notes you want to keep as a JSON file in Settings.
Operator details and questions about the app
Want to help make Tokipin better?
Usage statistics, like how often the app is opened and notes are saved, help us see what could work better and improve features. We don’t send the contents of your notes or your search terms.

If you opt in, Google Analytics processes app opens, note saves, an app installation identifier, and device information. We don’t send the contents or dates of your notes, or your search terms. You can turn sharing off at any time in Settings.
You can turn on “Share app usage statistics” anytime in Settings.
